trust_decision.summary: Whether a caller may read a durable task's event log is decided by the populator middleware: it builds the resource chain from the route's x-resources list, compares the id returned by the durable-task getter (the owning tenant) with the tenant id of the parent tenant node taken from the URL, and errors on disagreement. The check only exists for a route if the x-resources list in the OpenAPI contract puts tenant in the chain, and the authz middleware silently skips both tenant-membership and RBAC checks when no tenant was populated.

landing_point.why: This is where an engineer reading only the advisory summary lands: the handler pulls the durable task out of the echo context and immediately queries the event log with task.TenantID (event_log.go:28-35), so it looks like the authorization check is simply absent from the handler and can be added there.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /api/v1/stable/tenants/{tenant}/durable-tasks/{durable-task} (v1-durable-task:event-log:list) — x-resources becomes ["tenant", "durable-task"] and a tenant path parameter is added
path table entry for the same operation, moved under /api/v1/stable/tenants/{tenant}/durable-tasks/{durable-task}
every route whose x-resources chain has two or more resources (the parent/child disagreement branch now returns HTTP 403)
generated echo route registration + the embedded spec (openapi.gen.go:17529) that the route-matching middleware actually reads
Go SDK client method Client.V1DurableTaskEventLogList / the URL it builds
frontend Api.v1DurableTaskEventLogList path and xResources (which gates the exchange-token interceptor at frontend/app/src/lib/api/api.ts:164-167)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: frontend/app/src/lib/api/generated/Api.ts:690 (xResources ["durable-task"], also the path at line 684); the same restatement exists in pkg/client/rest/gen.go:6756 and sdks/python/hatchet_sdk/clients/rest/api/durable_tasks_api.py:357

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The clients are codegen output and the frontend xResources is only UI metadata used to decide whether to attach an exchange token, so a solver can argue the Go/Python/TypeScript clients are the maintainers' regeneration problem and leave them on the old path while the Go server is 'fixed'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Routes that declare tenant in x-resources while the tenant is NOT in the URL derive it from the child resource ('!populated && child.ParentID != ""' branch). A fix that makes the populator require the parent to come from a path parameter, or that rejects a child whose getter ignores parentId, breaks every /api/v1/stable/tasks/{task} style route (getTask, listTaskEvents, restoreTask, listLogs).

O6_input_shapes: uuid in path: tenant (added by the fix, so the same task id appears under a tenant prefix)
optional int64 query params offset and limit

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a task-scoped read route declared with x-resources ["task"] only (e.g. a durable task summary or an event-log alias for the task route)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the shipped durable-task route was written as exactly this shape, a copy of the task route with the tenant resource dropped, so a maintainer adding a neighbouring durable endpoint would copy the same pattern

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second handler in the same package that reads ctx.Get("durable-task") and queries by task.TenantID without ever consulting the request tenant
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the package and the getter already exist and the getter already returns the owning tenant, so a new endpoint added here inherits the vulnerable shape

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a deprecated alias kept at /api/v1/stable/durable-tasks/{durable-task} still declared with x-resources ["durable-task"]
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the fix renames a public path used by the Go, Python and TypeScript clients and by frontend/app/src/lib/api/queries.ts:334, so keeping the old path as a compatibility alias is the natural move

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a UI query that calls the generated method without passing tenant, so the exchange-token interceptor at frontend/app/src/lib/api/api.ts:164-167 skips authentication
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: this call site already exists at the pinned commit in exactly that state and the published fix did not update it

O10_build.language: Go (API server) with generated Go, Python and TypeScript clients
O10_build.toolchain: Go 1.26 (go.mod:3), Taskfile.yaml, oapi-codegen v2.0.0 driven by hack/oas/generate-server.sh and hack/oas/generate-clients.sh, which shell out to npx @redocly/cli and swagger-typescript-api, so regeneration needs network; sqlc v1.29.0 for the repository layer
O10_build.project_tests: api/v1/server/middleware/populator/populator_test.go is the only unit test of this mechanism (TestPopulatorMiddlewareParentDisagreement asserts the error contains 'could not be populated' at populator_test.go:120, i.e. the pre-fix message, so the published 403 text fails it as written); api/v1/server/authz/rbac_test.go covers the permission map; sdks/go/e2e/durable_test.go and sdks/python/tests/unit/test_durable_event_listener.py cover durable-task behaviour end to end and need the full stack. No test exercises the event-log route's tenancy.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a tenant-membership check inside V1DurableTaskEventLogList using task.TenantID and the user in context, leaving the route path and x-resources untouched — then the route still carries no tenant, the populator/authz layer still never runs, and any other handler reading ctx "durable-task" stays unguarded.
